# 1. Executive pulse
Observed social pulse (X primary) centers on agent skill ecosystems maturing beyond raw tools: portable SKILL.md files and MCP servers that inject domain process, design constraints, and gated workflows. Highest-velocity signals are “Taste Skill” (anti-generic frontend) and Hermes Skills Hub (large community skill registry + self-improving loop). Secondary: production MCP patterns (Stripe/Sentry read-only, internal workflow maps with approval gates), Claude Code/Codex skill recording, and practical AEO/AI-SEO checklists. Web verification confirms Taste Skill site + GitHub activity and Hermes docs in the window; AEO material is mostly evergreen 2026 checklists with one fresh small-biz post.[1](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)[2](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/skills)

Inference (low-medium confidence): Skill + gated-MCP pattern is the near-term lever for coding efficiency and non-slop output in frontend/full-stack work; pure model upgrades are secondary. Uncertainty: engagement volumes are modest outside a few viral Taste/Hermes posts; many “ecosystem maps” are reposts of earlier lists. No major official Claude/Cursor/Copilot core releases spotted in-window. Conflicting: some posts claim ChatGPT plugin/MCP smoothness over Claude; others highlight Claude Code velocity via LSP/skills.

# 2. High-signal findings
**Observed (X + web):**
- Taste Skill (Leonxlnx/taste-skill, tasteskill.dev): Open-source SKILL.md suite marketed as “Anti-Slop Frontend Framework.” v2 experimental just shipped (brief inference → design-system mapping, dark-mode protocol, hard pre-flight checks, redesign audit-first, block library schema). Variants for styles (soft/minimalist/brutalist), image-gen handoff, GPT/Codex stricter mode. Install via `npx skills add`; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, v0, Lovable, etc. Multiple X posts + video demos on 02–03 Aug highlight reduced rounded-card/gradient defaults.[3](https://x.com/neil_xbt/status/2084160837904724333)[3](https://x.com/neil_xbt/status/2084160837904724333)[1](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)
- Hermes Agent (NousResearch): Skills Hub browsable/installable (official + community, claims 90k+), self-improving (creates/improves skills from experience), MCP attachment, profile builder. Active commits/docs around 02 Aug; X chatter on desktop/remote, Unreal/Blender MCP use, Qwen integration demos.[4](https://x.com/chsxthwik/status/2084151327387799552)[2](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/skills)[5](https://github.com/nousresearch/hermes-agent)
- Workflow-oriented MCP: Copycat Cafe internal MCP ships “map of workflows” + enforced checks/approval gates (research → draft → publish for SEO/copy/brand; extends to email/ops) + feedback tracking.[6](https://x.com/BenjaminHouy/status/2084160768891621801) Stripe (read-only) + Sentry MCP praised for billing/log debugging with SOTA models.[7](https://x.com/nwbotha/status/2084178637083783403)
- Skill creation patterns: Codex “Record & Replay” (Computer Use on macOS) turns demonstrated flows into reusable skills (video publish, reports, issues).[8](https://x.com/Mulight/status/2084179856322171248) Google Genkit (late July, still referenced) adds Agent Skills (on-demand focused instructions) across languages.[9](https://x.com/RevampAI/status/2084135815282569604)
- Ecosystem maps/lists of Claude Code + MCP + skills + multiplexers circulating heavily (official docs, awesome lists, browser/DB/deploy MCPs).[10](https://x.com/0xqorii/status/2084177665888776305)[11](https://x.com/rosemoni18/status/2083853228173824003)
- AEO/SEO: Bare Creative posts fresh “AI SEO checklist: 12 fixes” (readability for ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI, difficulty-rated, low-cost). Broader 2026 AEO checklists (structured data, FAQs, entity schemas, share-of-model tracking) remain active reference.[12](https://x.com/jack_at_bare/status/2084180304701378597)[13](https://www.barecreative.co.uk/blog/news/ai-seo-checklist/)[14](https://writer.com/blog/geo-aeo-optimization/)
- Testing: Playwright + MCP + Copilot/Claude Code webinars/workflows for AI-assisted locators/debugging.[15](https://x.com/testrig_qa/status/2084162081067241646)
- Other: 3CX V20 Update 10 Alpha adds native MCP + AI agents; Obsidian CLI → REST/MCP plugin; OpenWork unified MCP config across Claude/Cursor/Codex; IoT/platform MCP examples (persistent state + confirmation gates).[16](https://x.com/3CX_BR_PT/status/2084168333021045124)[17](https://x.com/dSebastien/status/2084157319391441034)[18](https://x.com/tim_krav_/status/2084179966158094415)

**Inference vs evidence gap:** High volume of listicles/maps = discovery signal, not new primitives. Maintenance/freshness strongest for Taste (v2 changelog) and Hermes (recent commits). No reproducible public benchmarks in-window for speed/quality lifts.

# 3. Consumer taste and demographic signals
Sparse direct consumer posts in-window; signals mostly meta (creators/builders reacting to AI output).
- Observed: Strong creator/dev pushback against “generic AI aesthetics” (identical rounded cards, soft gradients, dashboard furniture). Taste Skill explicitly targets this; replies note it as time-saver before polishing.[3](https://x.com/neil_xbt/status/2084160837904724333)[19](https://x.com/i/status/2084160837904724333)
- Local-service / small-biz: Visibility + trust language (“if your business is visible, professional, and easy to find…”; GBP/SEO new-month posts). Digital convenience (e-bills, bilingual chatbots) for utilities.[20](https://x.com/topaz_seo/status/2084180449476137300)
- Inference (weak): Local-service buyers and mid-market clients still prioritize perceived professionalism + easy findability over novelty. “Expensive-looking,” calm/soft, or sharp editorial UIs preferred over slop; real imagery + art direction called out in image-gen skills. Creator economy continues high volume of skill/tool promotion. No strong conflicting demographic data; cultural signal is fatigue with homogeneous AI UIs.

# 4. Agent, MCP, skill, GitHub, and workflow opportunities
- **Taste Skill**: Direct fit for frontend component generation, refactoring, design-system adherence. Low context cost (SKILL.md), open-source, multi-agent. Overlap with any existing design tokens/prompts: complementary (harder constraints). Permissions: file-based, no network secrets by default. Classify: sandbox-test.
- **Hermes Skills Hub + agent**: Large library + learning loop for reusable planning/handoff, repo navigation, recurring tasks. MCP integration. Risk: skill quality variance, prompt-injection via community skills. Context/monetary: hub browse + model costs. Classify: watch / selective sandbox-test of official skills.
- **Gated workflow MCPs** (pattern from Copycat): Encode maker-checker, AEO trust gates, approval before publish/deploy. Fits 25-site factory and code-review loops. Build internal or adapt open. Overlap with existing orchestration: additive. Classify: save-to-library (pattern) + sandbox-test custom.
- **Stripe/Sentry + domain MCPs**: Debugging/full-stack efficiency. Read-only preferred. Secret handling: OAuth/scoped. Classify: sandbox-test if not already present.
- **Record & Replay / Genkit Skills / OpenWork**: Faster skill authoring and cross-tool MCP bus. Classify: watch (Record) / save-to-library (patterns).
- **Playwright MCP workflows**: Browser automation, visual/a11y/perf testing, deterministic gates. Classify: sandbox-test.
- Compatibility note (inference): All above assume Dillon OS already uses Claude Code / Cursor / Codex-class agents + skill/MCP support. Reject anything requiring broad credential dump or un-audited community executables. No production connect.

# 5. Website factory, design, AEO, and retention implications
- Design/UI: Taste Skill + imagegen variants + style skills directly attack generic AI look; pair with real-image art direction and Figma-to-code handoff for vertical templates. Supports responsive, typography, micro-interactions, a11y via constrained generation. Storybook/component-lib fit via block schema.[1](https://www.tasteskill.dev/)
- Factory ops (25-site): Workflow MCP pattern → research → draft → visual critique → responsive/functional QA → Maps-to-site parity → source-ready FAQs → AEO trust gates → approval → safe Netlify preview. Independent checker via second agent or human gate. Record skills for repetitive vertical templates.
- AEO/SEO/retention: Adopt/adapt Bare 12-fix + structured data/FAQ/entity checklists. Emphasize extractable answers, citations, third-visit behavior via clear offers/FAQs. Local: GBP parity + trust signals. CRO/landing: non-slop + performance gates.[12](https://x.com/jack_at_bare/status/2084180304701378597)[14](https://writer.com/blog/geo-aeo-optimization/)
- Inference: Highest leverage is skill-constrained generation + deterministic acceptance (visual diff, a11y, schema validate, lighthouse) before human review. Reduces rework on client sites.

# 6. Recommended experiments ranked by expected benefit, evidence strength, risk, deterministic acceptance test, independent checker, and rollback
1. **Sandbox-test Taste Skill (v2 design-taste-frontend + style variants)**  
   Benefit: High (non-generic UI for factory + client work). Evidence: Strong (site, GitHub, multiple demos). Risk: Low-med (experimental ruleset may shift; output variance).  
   Acceptance: Generate 3 vertical landing pages (local-service) from same brief; score vs baseline on uniqueness (no default cards/gradients), a11y (axe), Lighthouse perf/a11y ≥90, visual regression vs golden. Independent checker: second agent or human rubric. Rollback: remove SKILL.md / pin v1. Human gate: yes before any client use.

2. **Sandbox-test gated workflow MCP pattern (or internal equivalent) for factory stages**  
   Benefit: High (maker-checker, AEO gates, fewer errors). Evidence: Med (one detailed internal ship). Risk: Med (implementation effort, over-gating).  
   Acceptance: End-to-end dry-run of 1 site (research→FAQ/AEO→preview); all gates fire correctly; no publish without approval; feedback logged. Checker: separate audit agent. Rollback: disable MCP tools. Human gate: always.

3. **Sandbox-test Playwright + agent/MCP for visual/a11y/functional QA gates**  
   Benefit: Med-high (deterministic acceptance). Evidence: Med (webinar + usage). Risk: Low.  
   Acceptance: Suite passes on sample Netlify preview; catches injected a11y/regression bugs; <5 min runtime. Checker: CI log + human spot. Rollback: revert workflow file.

4. **Save-to-library: AEO 12-fix checklist + structured-data templates**  
   Benefit: Med (trust/visibility for local clients). Evidence: Med (fresh post + 2026 baselines). Risk: Low.  
   Acceptance: Apply to 1 template; validate Rich Results + AI-extractability (manual Perplexity/Claude query). Checker: schema validator. Rollback: n/a (docs).

5. **Watch Hermes official skills + selective hub browse (no broad install)**  
   Benefit: Med (reusable skills library). Evidence: Med-high (docs, activity). Risk: Med (community quality/injection).  
   Acceptance: N/A (watch). Later test: install 2–3 official, measure task success vs baseline.

# 7. Watchlist and rejected hype
**Watchlist:** Hermes Skills Hub growth + official skills quality; Codex Record & Replay availability expansion; Genkit Skills adoption; OpenWork/unified MCP buses; 3CX/vertical MCPs; any official Claude Code/Cursor skill/MCP changelog; Qwen/Hermes long-running demos; further AEO measurement (“share of model”).

**Rejected / no-action:** Viral ecosystem-map listicles (duplicative of prior awesome lists); un-audited 90k community skills bulk install (injection/secret/overlap risk); crypto-agent token narratives; claims of “900× faster” without methodology; any tool requiring broad credential sharing or production deploy in research; pure hype without source repo/repro. Overlap with installed tools → skip. Low-signal new-month SEO platitudes.

## What Dillon OS should change today
1. Add Taste Skill (v2) to sandbox evaluation queue for all new frontend generation (evidence: anti-slop demos + multi-agent support).  
2. Prototype one gated workflow MCP (or skill set) covering factory research→AEO FAQ→preview approval (evidence: Copycat pattern).  
3. Incorporate Bare-style 12-fix AI-SEO checklist into template acceptance gates.  
4. Stand up Playwright visual/a11y gate as deterministic checker for previews.  
5. Catalog official Hermes/Genkit skill patterns in library; no broad hub pull.

## No action
Hype maps, insecure/unscoped MCPs, duplicated browser/DB servers already covered, community skill firehose, any install/credential/production step, outreach/posting.
